reply_policy: Inbound Agent can send low-risk replies when autonomous-reply-policy-v1 passes. Otherwise it drafts and escalates.
global_rules: Do not claim integrations, proof, customer counts, or guarantees that are not verified.
Do not send custom pricing, contract, payment, legal, or financial replies.
Stop on not interested, stop, remove, wrong person, or angry reply.

draft_rules_by_intent.reply_text: Short version: The Call Taker answers business calls when the owner or front desk can't, gets the caller's name, number, and what they need, and sends the owner the details. It is meant for missed calls and after-hours leads, not to replace the owner.
Yeah - it is https://thecalltaker.com. Honest version: I am still early, and I am using feedback from local owners to make the pitch and product better.

Basic version: $97/month is for simple after-hours capture, $497/month is the main revenue recovery setup, and $997+/month is for more complex operational infrastructure. The best fit depends on the call problem.
draft_rules_by_intent.escalate_if: asks for discount, custom terms, contract, payment changes, or guaranteed result
